body:
Technicals is a technical analysis tool that combines the ratings of several technical indicators to make it easier for traders and investors to find profitable trades. S&P 500 Technical analysis tool is designed to have values that fluctuate above and below a zero line. Its values are plotted as a histogram of red, green and gray bars.

## Summary

Explore the S&P 500 technical analysis, featuring essential tools like S&P 500 moving averages, RSI, and pivot points to guide your trading decisions. This page helps you identify key support and resistance levels, track market trends, and spot buy or sell signals for S&P 500. You can customize your analysis by selecting from various timeframes, including 1 Minute, 5 Minutes, 15 Minutes, 30 Minutes, Hourly, 5 Hours, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly.
